Daily Devotional

May 4

6 Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life. 7 But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away: (2 Corinthians 3:6-7 KJV)

God makes ministers able. All ministers should have become ministers by the call of God, and not by choices of their own. If religion only had ministers that had been called by God, and anointed by Him, then religion would be much more accurate and effective than what it is. If you are not truly called by God to an office in the kingdom of God (Romans 12:6-8), then you should not be in that office, as without the anointing of God in your life, you will never be effective in that position.

This verse is telling us that the letter (Old Testament Law) was the same as killing us (Romans 7:10); where as the New Testament (Spirit) gives us life (Romans 6:23). This is pointed out many times in the Word of God, as the Old Testament Law was only to bring sin alive (Romans 7:9), and show us how hopeless we were in our sins. The New Testament Grace of God, brought into effect by Jesus, brought our right standing with God, back into reality, and Jesus did away with the Law by fulfilling it (Matthew 5:17). If the Old Testament Law, brought through Moses, brought Glory shinning in his face (Exodus 34:30), how much more does the New Testament Grace through Jesus, bring Glory to us. Let us let our light shine for the Lord (Matthew 5:16).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
